forwardable_moments.speaker: ALEX
forwardable_moments.text: So here's the kicker, folks. Databricks just dropped some numbers that'll twist your brain. Only 19% of organizations have deployed AI agents. Yet these agents are cranking out 97% of databases. Jamie, what’s the real story here?

forwardable_moments.speaker: RUFUS
forwardable_moments.text: Quite right, Alex. Cisco's reportedly in talks to acquire Astrix Security, an AI agent security startup, for over $250 million. Published by SiliconANGLE just yesterday.

forwardable_moments.speaker: RUFUS
forwardable_moments.text: Last but not least, Databricks reveals that only 19% of organizations are deploying AI agents, yet they’re creating 97% of databases. That’s a mind-bender, isn’t it?

forwardable_moments.speaker: JAMIE
forwardable_moments.text: True, and with Gartner predicting that 75% of enterprises will shift from pilot projects to full AI deployment by 2024, we're on the brink of a major shift.
